mapper.insert: insert into edu_ai_task (task_id,user_id,session_id,client_request_id,message,attachment_ids_json, attachment_context,status,cancel_requested,create_time,update_time) values (#{taskId},#{userId},#{sessionId},#{clientRequestId},#{message},#{attachmentIdsJson}, #{attachmentContext},#{status},0,sysdate(),sysdate()) on duplicate key update task_id = task_id
mapper.select: select from edu_ai_task where task_id=#{taskId} for update
select from edu_ai_task where task_id=#{taskId} and user_id=#{userId}
select from edu_ai_task where user_id=#{userId} and client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}
select from edu_ai_task where user_id=#{userId} and client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} for update
select from edu_ai_task where user_id=#{userId} and status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and session_id=#{sessionId} order by create_time desc
select from edu_ai_task where status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') order by create_time asc
select cancel_requested from edu_ai_task where task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: update edu_ai_task set status='RUNNING',start_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where task_id=#{taskId} and status='QUEUED' and cancel_requested=0
update edu_ai_task set status=#{status},result_json=#{resultJson},error_message=#{errorMessage}, finish_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where task_id=#{taskId} and status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
